text.text_excerpt: I was at this venue for New Orleans Fashion Week. This is a gorgeous place. It was hard to get a feel of the room because there was a big runway in the middle of it, but even with the runway where was a lot of space to move around and room for people to sit. The highlight for me was the outside: a beautiful patio'd courtyard with a nice garden adds to the "upscale" feel and makes you feel like you are at an exquisite manor. Parking is a pain, and I ended up having to park a few blocks away for the event that I attended, but that is the only minor drawback of the space and pretty typical for the area.

This building and courtyard is one of New Orleans premier wedding locales. I would put this right behind Southern Oaks Plantation as best places to get married in the city. The building itself is gorgeous with its huge main room, beautiful ceiling, and its adjacent courtyard. There are many events that take place here from cocktail parties, luncheons, weddings, and meetings. I have worked here quite a few times for weddings and parties and everything always runs smoothly. The caterers for these events are Pigeon Caterers. While I am not a big fan of Pigeon Caterers I do think they do provide guests with high quality food. I have attended several events here (most recently a wedding reception and cook off). The inside space is beautiful and can hold a good deal of people. The outside area is also nice, with a fountain and a nice wrought iron fence. The building was also used for several scenes in the movie Bad Lieutenant Port of Call New Orleans. Parking on the street is extremely limited, but there are several lots on Poydras that are within walking distance.
